# Pascal Rodriguez

> CTO & Partner at Visium SA in Lausanne, Switzerland. Builds trusted agentic AI for regulated industries (life sciences, pharma, biotech) and leads the engineering teams that run it. Twenty-two years in software; before Visium, Director of Engineering at Bestmile through its acquisition by ZF Group. Dad, triathlete, Ironman finisher.
